assumptions: OpenCode 2.x as installed (2.1.4 CLI; 2.1.2 documentation consulted); plugin, MCP, skill and permission behaviour is unverified until REQ-002; Codex/Claude native plugins, the bundled runtime and the SPEC-042 lifecycle engine are reused; owner decisions D1 to D11 recorded (codemode false, legacy protocol, global plugin, portable server only through the legacy profile, version 0.1.0-alpha.6). Plan (2026-11-03): OpenCode facts in research.md R1-R7 are documented (OpenCode 2.1.2 docs), not observed; T002 observes them and contradictions return to the owner. Open plan decisions OD-9 (SC-010 measured on host-read files) and OD-10 (legacy OpenCode server name agent-braid-tooling) await owner review.
compatibility: Additive: agent-braid-plugin/v0.2, agent-braid-tooling/v0.2, Codex and Claude Code packages, ADR 0030 naming and SPEC-042 receipts unchanged; install.sh gains an opencode host; the legacy tooling install route is frozen apart from the new opencode profile.
domain: Agent Braid native host integration for OpenCode: plugin package, MCP registration, skills and commands, setup and reconnection, lifecycle, shell installer, legacy profile, telemetry and System One invariants, distribution, documentation.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false for every tool, skill and command; OpenCode permissions and approvals are host decisions, not Agent Braid grants; no plugin hook; grants remain operator-issued outside the host; no automatic MCP reload.
hypotheses: None; engineering specification with no scientific claim.
observation_contract: Host matrix and native observation record OpenCode version, platform, command, observed behaviour and limits in a disposable profile; unobserved items stay unobserved; OpenCode session identifiers are never stored.

scientific_limits: Engineering only. Deterministic tests with fake executables prove logic, not native host behaviour; the host matrix and native observation describe one OpenCode version and platform; no utility, safety or compatibility claim beyond observed rows. Structural validation is not founder approval.
scope: Specification only: OpenCode native plugin reusing the bundled runtime and agent-braid-plugin/v0.2 MCP server, unprefixed skills with collision warning, explicit reconnection, native lifecycle and legacy migration, install.sh opencode host, receipt-owned legacy opencode profile, unchanged telemetry/System One contracts, provenance, documentation and a separate native observation gate.
